name: Production environments MUST NOT communicate with Non-Production environments (Segmentation) to prevent a test environment compromise from spreading to live systems.
conditionsText: Any applicable in house built service
requirementTitle: Production environments MUST NOT communicate with Non-Production environments (Segmentation) to prevent a test environment compromise from spreading to live systems.
requirementDescription: Production systems should be isolated from development, test, and UAT environments. A compromise in a non-production environment should not provide a path into live production systems.
why:
Non-production environments are often less secure than production because they may have:
- Weaker access controls
- Shared accounts
- Less monitoring
- Experimental code
- Temporary configurations
Attackers know this.
tasks: Production environments MUST NOT communicate with Non-Production environments (Segmentation) to prevent a test environment compromise from s

actions.title: Production environments MUST NOT communicate with Non-Production environments (Segmentation) to prevent a test environment compromise from s
actions.description: Keep Production and Non-Production environments separate. If a development or test system is compromised, the attacker should not be able to use it as a stepping stone into live production services or data.
